Kulsums Collection is an online Indian ethnic-wear shop. It sells clothing, kurtis, lehengas, western wear, cord sets & plazos, dress material, pakistani suits, readymade suits, kids clothing & accessories, home needs, abayas,  jwellery & accessories, bags, jwellery. Prices are in Indian rupees and include GST where applicable. Free shipping. Delivery in 4–7 working days. Ships across India.

## Customer information
- Shipping: Free shipping. Delivery in 4–7 working days. Ships across India.
- Returns and exchanges: Exchanges are accepted within 3 days of delivery for unused items with original tags and packaging. Sale items and customised pieces cannot be exchanged. To initiate an exchange, message us with your order number and a 360 degree view of parcel opening video of the item. Only if items received are damaged or if the quality of item is poor, those items will be eligible for exchange and/or refund. 
- Payment: UPI.
- Order tracking: https://kulsumscollection.com/?page=track (needs the order number and mobile number)
- Contact: WhatsApp 8624960319, phone 8624960319, email kulsum.nazmeen.2016@gmail.com. Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 10pm
- About: About Us

Kulsums Collection is a small business built with love, passion, and the support of our customers.🤍

We believe beautiful products should be accessible without compromising on quality. Our aim is to bring you carefully selected clothing, abayas, jewellery, and more at affordable prices, while making your shopping experience simple, comfortable, and trustworthy.

For us, every customer matters. We value your trust, your feedback, and every order you place with us. We may be a small business, but we believe in giving every customer the personal attention and care they deserve.

We are constantly exploring new collections and bringing you something fresh, while keeping **quality, affordability, and customer satisfaction at the heart of everything we do.

✨ And making your experience even more lively are our little promoters, Zyan & Noor! Their cheerful presence adds a little extra joy to the Kulsums Collection family. 🤍

We also believe that when we are blessed with something, it is beautiful to share those blessings with others. 🤲

That is why  ₹1 from your every purchase will be contributed towards charity. So, with every order, you are not only bringing something beautiful home, but also becoming a small part of a good cause. ❤️

Keep shopping, keep supporting our small business, and together, let's keep giving. 🌸

Thank you for supporting our small business and being a part of our journey. Your support means more to us than you know. 🤍



## Common questions
- **How long does delivery take?** Orders are packed within 1–2 days and usually arrive in 4–7 working days.
- **Do you offer cash on delivery?** Yes, cash on delivery is available on most orders. You will see it at checkout.
- **Can I return or exchange?** Exchanges are accepted within 3 days of delivery for unused items with tags. Message us with your order number to start.
- **Are colours the same as the photos?** We photograph in daylight, but screens vary, so the shade may differ slightly.
